# Scrape Summary Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Make `scrape <document-url>` workflows return a readable, somewhat detailed summary generated by the `reduce` step instead of raw serialized scrape payloads.

**Architecture:** Keep the existing DAG shape (`scrape` -> `reduce`) and implement the missing scrape-aware reduce behavior in the worker. Add deterministic text cleanup and summary extraction for scraped document text, then update the synthesizer formatter to prefer processed `reduce_result` output over raw scrape JSON.

**Tech Stack:** TypeScript, Vitest, Yjs, existing worker/synthesizer agents

---

```ts
it('reduces scrape results into a structured document summary', async () => {
  const agent = new NodeWorkerAgent({ gpuProfile: GPU_PROFILE });
  const doc = (agent as unknown as { doc: Y.Doc }).doc;
  const workflow = createWorkflow(doc, 'wf-scrape-reduce', 'worker-1', 'scrape aws pdf');
  const dagMap = workflow.get('dag') as Y.Map<Y.Map<unknown>>;
  const edges = workflow.get('edges') as Y.Array<unknown>;

  dagMap.set('task-scrape', createTaskNode('task-scrape', 'scrape', 'completed', {
    type: 'scrape_result',
    url: 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/doc.pdf',
    contentType: 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
    format: 'text',
    content: [
      'Title: AWS Prescriptive Guidance - Cloud design patterns, architectures, and implementations',
      'URL Source: http://docs.aws.amazon.com/doc.pdf',
      'Markdown Content:',
      '# Cloud design patterns, architectures, and implementations',
      'This guide provides guidance for implementing modernization design patterns by using AWS services.',
      '# Table of Contents',
      'Anti-corruption layer pattern',
      'Circuit breaker pattern',
      'Saga patterns',
      'Transactional outbox pattern',
    ].join('\n\n'),
  }));

  dagMap.set('task-reduce', createTaskNode('task-reduce', 'reduce', 'pending', { prompt: 'Process and structure extracted data' }));
  edges.push([{ id: 'edge-1', source: 'task-scrape', target: 'task-reduce', type: 'sequential' }]);

  const result = await (agent as unknown as {
    executeTask: (task: TaskNode, workflowId?: string) => Promise<unknown>;
  }).executeTask({
    id: 'task-reduce',
    type: 'reduce',
    description: 'Process and structure extracted data',
    status: 'pending',
    claimedBy: null,
    args: { prompt: 'Process and structure extracted data' },
    result: null,
    error: null,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    startedAt: null,
    completedAt: null,
  }, 'wf-scrape-reduce');

  expect(result).toMatchObject({
    type: 'reduce_result',
    sourceType: 'scrape_result',
    title: 'Cloud design patterns, architectures, and implementations',
    sections: expect.arrayContaining(['Anti-corruption layer pattern', 'Circuit breaker pattern', 'Saga patterns']),
    takeaways: expect.any(Array),
    confidence: expect.any(Number),
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Add helper functions inside `src/agents/worker/worker.ts` for predecessor lookup and text cleanup**

Add small internal helpers in the same file:

```ts
private getWorkflowNodeMap(workflowId: string): Y.Map<Y.Map<unknown>> {
  const workflow = getActiveWorkflows(this.doc).get(workflowId);
  if (!workflow) throw new Error(`Workflow not found: ${workflowId}`);

  const dagMap = workflow.get('dag') as Y.Map<Y.Map<unknown>> | undefined;
  if (!dagMap) throw new Error(`Workflow ${workflowId} is missing DAG nodes`);
  return dagMap;
}

private getCompletedPredecessorResults(workflowId: string, taskId: string): unknown[] {
  const workflow = getActiveWorkflows(this.doc).get(workflowId);
  if (!workflow) throw new Error(`Workflow not found: ${workflowId}`);

  const dag = this.readWorkflowDag(workflow);
  return dag.getPredecessors(taskId)
    .map((id) => dag.getNode(id))
    .filter((node): node is TaskNode => node !== undefined)
    .filter((node) => node.status === 'completed' && node.result !== null)
    .map((node) => node.result);
}

private cleanExtractedDocumentText(raw: string): string {
  return raw
    .replace(/^Title:.*$/gmu, '')
    .replace(/^URL Source:.*$/gmu, '')
    .replace(/^Published Time:.*$/gmu, '')
    .replace(/^Markdown Content:.*$/gmu, '')
    .replace(/^>\s*[ivxlcdm0-9]+.*$/gimu, '')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim();
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Add deterministic scrape summary extraction helpers in the same file**

Add helpers that derive the title, section headings, overview, and takeaways from cleaned text.

```ts
private deriveDocumentTitle(text: string): string | null {
  const heading = text.match(/^#\s+(.+)$/m)?.[1]?.trim();
  if (heading) return heading;

  const firstLine = text.split('\n').map((line) => line.trim()).find(Boolean);
  return firstLine ?? null;
}

private deriveSectionHeadings(text: string): string[] {
  const headings = text.match(/^#\s+(.+)$/gm) ?? [];
  const normalized = headings
    .map((line) => line.replace(/^#\s+/u, '').trim())
    .filter((line) => line.length > 0 && line.toLowerCase() !== 'table of contents');

  return Array.from(new Set(normalized)).slice(0, 6);
}

private buildOverview(text: string): string {
  const paragraphs = text.split(/\n\s*\n/u).map((part) => part.trim()).filter((part) => part.length > 0);
  return paragraphs.slice(0, 2).join(' ');
}

private deriveTakeaways(text: string, headings: string[]): string[] {
  const bullets = headings.slice(0, 4).map((heading) => `Discusses ${heading}.`);
  return bullets.length > 0 ? bullets : [this.buildOverview(text)];
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Replace the `reduce` stub with scrape-aware logic**

Update the `task.type === 'reduce'` branch so it reads predecessor results and generates a structured `reduce_result` for scrape inputs.

```ts
if (task.type === 'reduce') {
  if (!workflowId) {
    throw new Error('Reduce tasks require a workflow context');
  }

  const predecessorResults = this.getCompletedPredecessorResults(workflowId, task.id);
  const scrapeResult = predecessorResults.find((result) => (
    typeof result === 'object'
    && result !== null
    && (result as { type?: unknown }).type === 'scrape_result'
  )) as {
    type: 'scrape_result';
    content?: unknown;
  } | undefined;

  if (!scrapeResult || typeof scrapeResult.content !== 'string' || scrapeResult.content.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new Error(`Reduce task ${task.id} has no usable scrape content`);
  }

  const cleaned = this.cleanExtractedDocumentText(scrapeResult.content);
  const title = this.deriveDocumentTitle(cleaned);
  const sections = this.deriveSectionHeadings(cleaned);
  const summary = this.buildOverview(cleaned);
  const takeaways = this.deriveTakeaways(cleaned, sections);

  return {
    type: 'reduce_result',
    sourceType: 'scrape_result',
    title,
    summary,
    sections,
    takeaways,
    confidence: 0.85,
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Add structured formatting for `reduce_result` fragments**

Add a small formatter in `src/agents/synthesizer/reducer.ts` that recognizes `reduce_result` payloads and renders them as readable markdown.

```ts
function formatReduceResult(content: {
  title?: unknown;
  summary?: unknown;
  sections?: unknown;
  takeaways?: unknown;
}): string {
  const title = typeof content.title === 'string' ? content.title : 'Document Summary';
  const summary = typeof content.summary === 'string' ? content.summary : '';
  const sections = Array.isArray(content.sections) ? content.sections.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string') : [];
  const takeaways = Array.isArray(content.takeaways) ? content.takeaways.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string') : [];

  const lines = [title, '', summary];

  if (sections.length > 0) {
    lines.push('', 'Key Sections');
    lines.push(...sections.map((section) => `- ${section}`));
  }

  if (takeaways.length > 0) {
    lines.push('', 'Notable Takeaways');
    lines.push(...takeaways.map((takeaway) => `- ${takeaway}`));
  }

  return lines.join('\n').trim();
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Update `consolidate()` to prefer formatted reduce output**

Update the map in `consolidate()` so `reduce_result` fragments use `formatReduceResult`, while all other fragment types keep the existing fallback.

```ts
const parts = sorted.map((o) => {
  const content = o.content;
  const body = typeof content === 'object'
    && content !== null
    && (content as { type?: unknown }).type === 'reduce_result'
    ? formatReduceResult(content as Record<string, unknown>)
    : JSON.stringify(content);

  return `[Task ${o.taskId}] (confidence: ${(o.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%)\n${body}`;
});
```
